reason: The proof is correct. The lower bound validly double-counts all horizontal and vertical length-three triples, each removed block meeting at most 14 of them. The periodic construction covers every grid triple, and truncation only loses designated cells within two boundary columns on either side; the greedy completion therefore adds at most 4n disjoint blocks. The cases n=1,2 are also covered, yielding c=2/7 and d=5.
